title: Mutual monopoly trade where Alpha can build first
description: Mutual monopoly trade where Alpha can build first. Alpha can build orange immediately while Beta's yellow build cash is weak. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, let’s both get a monopoly! I’ll give you Atlantic Avenue + $60 for your New York Avenue. Then we each have a full color set.
final_action.private_thought: Beta holds New York (orange) while I have the other two orange properties. Trading Atlantic for New York plus $60 gives me the orange monopoly and gives Beta the yellow monopoly. This mutually beneficial trade should improve both our positions and increase my chance to build houses quickly.
